a21cc43a35d77457657a6d51cb119e46e388ca15.summary: Dutch firm Tesorion released a free decrypter for the Lorenz ransomware, which can recover some files without paying the ransom. A bug in Lorenz's encryption permanently destroys the last 48 bytes of files whose size is a multiple of 48 bytes. The decrypter works only in some cases. Lorenz was first seen in spring, appears to have evolved from ThunderCrypt and SZ40, targets enterprises, and its leak site listed thirteen victims.

a2f93627151b2f4861d95ccc169e793a69bf5114.summary: A Validin blog post (published 2025-01-16) on the North Korean-linked Lazarus APT and its Contagious Interview campaign. Lazarus uses ClickFix lures with fake recruiter contact and video interviews to get job seekers to run malicious code. The post shows how to pivot from known indicators to find related infrastructure, and stresses that pivot results need verification and may include false positives.
